title: New Feature Request: Integration of Ambrosias BluCon for Libre
symptom: The issue is a feature request to integrate the Ambrosia BluCon NFC to Bluetooth reader to read Abbott's Libre data.
fix: The fix is to use the Sept 6th Nightly build of xDrip, which includes the integration and works well.
evidence_quote: Can you try the Sept 6th Nightly and see if this works for you.
